name: Zhongcai proposed Central Asia data center near Bakhty
notes: Chinese investor delegation presented multiple Abai Region projects near Bakhty, including a proposed 'largest data center in Central Asia'; no capacity or construction start disclosed.

name: Semey data center facility
notes: Aggregate/job evidence indicates one data center market/provider in Semey and on-site technician support for mission-critical data center facilities; facility name/operator not independently confirmed.

name: Kazteleport Yereymentau Data Center
notes: DCD reports Kazteleport launched a facility located in Ereymentau with 100 racks and 2 MW of IT capacity; Ereymentau is in Akmola Region, though the article frames the facility as serving Astana.

name: GK Hyperscale Akmola Region Tier III data center
notes: Kazakhstan/GK Hyperscale project described as two Tier III hyperscale data centers totaling 200 MW; QazProjects places the primary facility in an Akmola industrial zone near Astana, implying about 100 MW per site.

name: Freedom Data Centers Aktobe
notes: Yandex Maps lists a 24-hour Freedom Data Centers data center at Aktobe, Altyn Orda microdistrict 21G; no independent capacity found.

name: Qazmin Aktobe data center
notes: Yandex Maps lists Qazmin as a data center at Aktobe, Kuraily residential area 397B/1; no capacity or certification found.

name: AQ Group Crypto Farm No. 2
notes: Listed as a data center/crypto farm in Aktobe on Yandex Maps; treated as server-farm activity, with no capacity found.

name: Freedom Cloud Data Center - Alatau Technopark
notes: Project at Alatau Technopark near Almaty; QazProjects reports construction began April 18, 2025, with 480 racks, 7.2 MW IT capacity and 13 MW total power consumption.

name: Beeline Kazakhstan Hyper Cloud Data Center
developer: Beeline Kazakhstan / VEON; Hyper Cloud Solution
notes: VEON says Beeline Kazakhstan began construction of a Tier III Hyper Cloud data center in Almaty, targeted to go live by end-2026; Data Center Map reports planned capacity of 2 MW.

name: Kazteleport Sairam Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute lists the Kazteleport Sairam Data Center in Almaty; DCD says the Tier III Sairam site opened in 2022 and offers 2 MW.

name: Kazteleport Masanchi Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists Kazteleport's Masanchi Data Center on Masanchi Street in Almaty as part of Kazteleport's Almaty data center footprint; capacity not found.

name: Kazteleport Khan Tengri Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists Kazteleport's Khan Tengri Data Center on Dostyk Avenue 39 in Almaty; capacity not found.

name: Makat Data Center
developer: Unknown customer; power solution by Altaaqa Global
notes: Altaaqa Global reports delivering, installing and commissioning a 40 MW mobile gas power plant for the Makat data center in Atyrau Region; MW reflects power solution capacity, not confirmed IT load.

name: National Information Technologies Uralsk Data Center
notes: AllDC/Profit.kz report says a National Information Technologies data center was commissioned in West Kazakhstan Region as part of a state server internet platform project.

name: Megakhost Kazakhstan Uralsk
notes: Yandex Maps lists Megakhost Kazakhstan at Abay Avenue 59/3 in Uralsk as website hosting/data center; no capacity found.

name: Transtelecom Bayterek District Data Center
notes: Yandex Maps lists a Transtelecom data center in West Kazakhstan Region, Bayterek District, Baiqonys rural district; no capacity found.

name: GK Hyperscale Temirtau Tier III data center
notes: Part of the GK Hyperscale Kazakhstan two-site Tier III development totaling 200 MW; QazProjects places the secondary site in Temirtau, Karaganda Region, implying about 100 MW per site.

name: Freedom Cloud Karagandy
notes: ColoMap lists Freedom Cloud Karagandy as a Freedom Telecom colocation data center at Uchyotny kvartal 132, 168, Karaganda; Yandex Cloud lists the same Freedom Telecom data center as a Kazakhstan point of presence.

name: Freedom Cloud Karaganda Stage 2 Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute award listing identifies Freedom Cloud Karaganda Stage 2 Data Center in Karaganda, Kazakhstan, under Freedom Data Centers LLP; capacity not found.

name: Data and Technology 2GIS for Business Kostanay data center
notes: 2GIS search result shows one Kostanay data-center listing at Kostanay Plaza; this is weak directory evidence and should be verified before use in investment analysis.
